atlases.prompt: Game animation sprite atlas: EXACTLY EIGHT consecutive frames, arranged as an exact FOUR-column by TWO-row grid of equal cells. Read left to right across the top row then the bottom row. Use the supplied softly shaded high-resolution 3D storybook Santa style exactly, with gentle upper-left lighting and detailed but consistent fabric. Same friendly plump Santa in every frame: same head, face, hat, white beard, red coat, white trim, black belt with gold buckle, white gloves, black boots. Keep the head, hat, torso, belt and hips IDENTICAL in size and position within every equal cell; animate only limbs and tiny natural body compression. No resizing or changing proportions between cells. All eight Santas face SCREEN RIGHT in the same three-quarter side view as the supplied running reference. Create ONE coherent complete eight-phase RUN cycle: cell1 near boot forward heel/contact with weight on that sole; cell2 same support leg compressed/down with the sole planted; cell3 passing position support boot under hips and other knee forward; cell4 brief airborne push/flight; cell5 opposite boot forward contact, reversing the arm/leg support from cell1; cell6 opposite support leg compressed/down; cell7 opposite passing position; cell8 brief opposite airborne flight returning naturally into cell1. Both halves of the cycle must alternate which leg supports the body. Each grounded frame has one flat planted boot sole at a shared ground baseline. Keep body bounce tiny and the head/torso consistent, no big leaps. Transparent background with true alpha, including margins between all cells. Full body contained completely inside every cell with generous transparent padding, no clipping. No text, numbers, labels, dividers, ground lines, floor, shadows, glow, scenery or extra characters. Every cell contains exactly one complete Santa, two arms and two legs.
atlases.cleanupPrompt: Edit this eight-frame Santa running sprite atlas ONLY to remove its background. Preserve the exact eight figures, their exact pixels, full silhouettes, positions, sizes and four-column/two-row layout. Remove ALL the pale white/checker pattern between and around the figures. Every background pixel including all four corners and inter-cell gutters must have alpha=0, truly transparent. Preserve white beard, white coat trim, white hat trim and white gloves fully opaque. Do not repaint, recolor, redraw, move or resize any part of Santa; no checkerboard pattern, no floor, no shadow, no replacement colored background.
